messages.subject: Changing legend labels with scale_colour_gradientn
parts:
I am having difficulties in changing the labels of a legend generated
by scale_colour_gradientn - it seems that the labels argument has no
effect on the outcome.

Consider the following example:
dsub <- subset(diamonds, x > 5 & x < 6 & y > 5 & y < 6)
dsub$diff <- with(dsub, sqrt(abs(x-y))* sign(x-y))
d <- qplot(x, y, data=dsub, colour=diff)

nbr <- 5
breaks <- seq(-0.4, 0.6, length.out = nbr)
nlabel = letters[1:nbr]
d + scale_colour_gradientn(colour = rainbow(7), breaks = breaks, label
= nlabel)

The breaks have been updated, but not the labels.

Any ideas how to get around this?
